_about: The models each installed app carries inside it: Velox (fast) and Scriba (it thinks) of Ingenium's lineup, listed in ingenium.html (ING_LINEUP), which also installs the others in the app. The cloud build downloads each from Hugging Face and refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches; tools/check_lineup.py checks this file against the page. Change a model here and the next build carries it; set a platform to null to build that app without built-in models. One file on a GitHub release may be at most 2 GB, so the models of one app must stay well under that together.

android.name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct
android.why: Velox on Fire tablets and Android: built for devices, it answers at once.

android.name: LFM2.5 1.2B Thinking
android.why: Scriba on Fire tablets and Android: the same small model trained to reason first, so the thinking bar shows its thoughts.

ios.name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct
ios.why: Velox on iPhone and iPad: it answers at once.

ios.name: Qwen3.5 2B
ios.why: Scriba on iPhone and iPad: broad knowledge in many languages, and it thinks step by step when asked.
